primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to week 12 in MRI-assessed liver fat (%), compared with placebo.
efficacy_outcome: At week 12, the liver-fat ratio was 0.79 with Epanova + dapagliflozin and 0.97 with placebo (p=0.046).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/22 with Epanova + dapagliflozin, 0/20 with Epanova, 1/21 with dapagliflozin, and 1/21 with placebo; deaths not reported.
